Learning resource fixture

This page is the article-schema credit fixture. It carries a LearningResource block with an author and a modified date, which is one of the six types the GEO scanner accepts in place of Article, so the article-schema check must pass here and the page must earn the credit.

Updated 2026-11-01.

The credit list under the rubric

The article-schema check accepts Article, BlogPosting, NewsArticle, TechArticle, Book, and LearningResource. Any one of them satisfies the check; this page uses LearningResource because the distribution's own learning pages use that type, and because the original scanner fixed exactly this false positive on book and learning pages during the October passes.

Author and freshness signals

The block names its author as a Person with a name and a profile URL, and it carries both a publication date and a modified date. A visible time element above repeats the modified date, so the visible-byline check has something to find. The suite asserts a 100 percent pass rate for the article checks on this page.

Everything else on this page follows the healthy pattern of the fixture home: complete metadata, exactly one heading of level one, no skipped heading levels, a main landmark, and a navigation block with more than five internal links plus one outbound citation. The outbound link points at an example source outside the fixture origin, which is all the outbound-citations check needs to pass.

If any article check starts failing here without an edit to this file, the scanner has drifted from the rubric, and the pinned assertions fail. Update the fixture only when a rubric change is deliberate, and record the reason next to the assertion that pins the new value.
